text: Replace pointwise BCE with a sampled within-user listwise softmax loss over each eligible training user’s one positive impression and four randomly sampled negative impressions, retaining the factorization-machine architecture, request-context features, split, checkpointing, and fixed ranking evaluation unchanged.
rationale: Experiment 2 reaches primary 0.60293 with GAUC 0.66891 and nDCG@5 0.53696, but pointwise training is misaligned with the fixed within-user ranking objective. A bounded sampled listwise loss tests the recent listwise direction while avoiding the abandoned full-user softmax formulation’s memory and patch complexity. It should improve ordering among users with mixed labels, especially the two_to_four positive segment where primary is 0.72013, while keeping runtime bounded and preventing validation leakage.
